concepts.def: Dense positive nucleus with electrons orbiting; from gold foil alpha scattering (Rutherford 1911).
Atoms of same element with different neutron numbers; same chemical properties, different mass.
Ionises sample, accelerates ions, deflects in magnetic field; identifies isotopes by m/z (Aston 1919).
Distribution of electrons in shells/subshells; follows Aufbau, Pauli, Hund principles.
Discrete coloured lines emitted when excited electrons fall to lower energy levels; evidence for quantised energy.
Energy to remove one mole of electrons from one mole of gaseous atoms; first IE increases across period.
